publication_type: bilingual dedicated legal/recovery dossier plus cross-site preservation module

controlling_proposition.es: No hay un único reloj: prescripción penal, prescripción civil, caducidad, responsabilidad del administrador concursal, responsabilidad patrimonial, daños, restitución y cautelares deben analizarse por acción, titular, demandado, trigger y remedio.
controlling_proposition.en: There is no single clock: criminal prescription, civil limitation, caducity, insolvency-administrator liability, State liability, damages, restitution and interim relief must be analysed by claim, right-holder, defendant, trigger and remedy.

legal_controls.criminal_prescription: CP arts. 131-132. Court-directed proceedings against a sufficiently identified person interrupt under the statutory requirements; a complaint/querella filed before a judicial body can suspend computation for up to six months pending the qualifying judicial resolution. Ordinary prosecutor/police/admin reporting is not described as automatic art.132 interruption.
legal_controls.civil_prescription: CC arts. 1964, 1968, 1969 and 1973, with same-facts criminal/civil Supreme Court doctrine applied only where the legal bridge exists.
legal_controls.caducity: Article 1535, article 1524, LPH art.18 and other strict periods remain separate from prescription; criminal proceedings do not automatically freeze or revive them.
legal_controls.ac_liability: Historical Ley Concursal art.36 / current TRLC arts.94-98 require act-, claimant-, harm- and cessation-specific analysis rather than one global AC expiry date.
legal_controls.state_liability: LOPJ arts.292-293 judicial-error / abnormal-functioning routes have separate predicates and special periods and are not merged with personal-criminal hypotheses.
legal_controls.recovery: CP arts.109-112, 121-122 and civil/insolvency/State routes are preserved as distinct restitution/damages bases with no double counting.
legal_controls.interim_relief: LECrim arts.589 and 764, CP art.127 octies, LEC arts.721/727/728 and LPH art.18.4 are treated as proportionate asset/evidence/value preservation mechanisms, not automatic consequences of an allegation.

public_prohibitions: A Fiscalía complaint automatically stops criminal prescription.
A criminal case freezes every civil deadline.
Continuing economic harm proves a continuing/permanent offence.
All retracto/tanteo rights remain alive because criminal proceedings exist.
Every insolvency-administrator act has one limitation date.
A criminal allegation automatically freezes CAM/HNT/MYND assets.
The whole current hotel value is automatically recoverable on top of every other damages head.
